crossRefs.note: You will keep whoever’s mind is steadfast in perfect peace, because he trusts in you.
Trust in Yahweh forever; for in Yah, Yahweh, is an everlasting Rock.
Then Moses said to Aaron, “This is what Yahweh spoke of, saying, ‘I will show myself holy to those who come near me…
Yahweh said to Moses and Aaron, “Because you didn’t believe in me, to sanctify me in the eyes of the children of…
These are the waters of Meribah; because the children of Israel strove with Yahweh, and he was sanctified in them.
because in the strife of the congregation, you rebelled against my word in the wilderness of Zin, to honor me as holy…
Yet, looking to the promise of God, he didn’t waver through unbelief, but grew strong through faith, giving glory to…
The God of Abraham, and the God of Nahor, the God of their father, judge between us.” Then Jacob swore by the fear of…
You, even you, are to be feared. Who can stand in your sight when you are angry?
“My covenant was with him of life and peace; and I gave them to him that he might be reverent toward me; and he was…
Don’t be afraid of those who kill the body, but are not able to kill the soul. Rather, fear him who is able to destroy…
But I will warn you whom you should fear. Fear him who after he has killed, has power to cast into Gehenna. Yes, I tell…
Who wouldn’t fear you, Lord, and glorify your name? For you only are holy. For all the nations will come and worship…

translations.web: Yahweh of Armies is who you must respect as holy. He is the one you must fear. He is the one you must dread.
translations.bsb: The LORD of Hosts is the One you shall regard as holy. Only He should be feared; only He should be dreaded.
translations.kjv: Sanctify the LORD of hosts himself; and let him be your fear, and let him be your dread.
translations.asv: Jehovah of hosts, him shall ye sanctify; and let him be your fear, and let him be your dread.
